mapper.select: SELECT COUNT("bs"."bus_stop_id") FROM "bus_stops" "bs" JOIN "line_bus_stops" "lbs" ON "lbs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lbs"."bus_stop_id" = "bs"."bus_stop_id" JOIN "line_routes" "lr" ON "lr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lr"."available_flag" = 1 AND "lr"."rosen_id" = "lbs"."rosen_id" JOIN "line_route_bus_stops" "lrbs" ON "lrbs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lrbs"."line_route_id" = "lr"."line_route_id" WHERE "bs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "bs"."available_flag" = 1 AND "bs"."bus_stop_id" = #{busStopId} AND "lbs"."rosen_bus_stop_id" = "lrbs"."rosen_bus_stop_id" AND ("lr"."service_start_date" < CAST(#{serviceStartDate} AS date) OR "lr"."service_end_date" > CAST(#{serviceEndDate} AS date))
SELECT "lrbs"."stop_sequence" FROM "line_route_bus_stops" AS "lrbs" WHERE "lrbs"."line_route_bus_stop_id" = CAST(#{lineRouteBusStopId} AS INTEGER)
